purpose: Jev-assisted visual and entry-rule wording review during the Spike build
data_scope: Generated loopback Dhan fixture screenshots and focused UI rule descriptions. No production sessions, credentials, personal data or real positions.
transport: Live-documented HTTP API from TypeScript; official SDK unavailable in the existing installation

questions.desktop_time_labels_clipped: Is a chart's rightmost time label cut off horizontally in `screenshots.desktop`?
questions.mobile_time_labels_clipped: Is a NIFTY chart's rightmost time label cut off horizontally in `screenshots.mobile_top`?
questions.mobile_paper_only_visible: Does `screenshots.mobile_top` visibly label the monitor as paper only?
questions.desktop_premium_vwap_separate: Are the minimum-straddle premium and VWAP shown in separate plots in `screenshots.desktop`?
questions.upward_exact_crossover: Does `entry_rule_text.upward` require the 5% move to already qualify at the VWAP crossover?
questions.downward_rolling_window: Does `entry_rule_text.downward` explicitly limit the earlier comparison value to the preceding thirty minutes?
questions.negative_delayed_exact_crossover: Does `entry_rule_text.delayed_negative` require the 5% move to already qualify at the VWAP crossover?

negative_case: After an upward VWAP crossover, wait until the premium becomes 5% higher, then enter the call spread.
actions: Browser geometry reproduced clipped rightmost time labels on all four desktop charts; fitted endpoint labels now anchor inside the canvas.
The downward entry description now explicitly names price-driven VWAP crossover timing and the preceding thirty-minute comparison window.
Initial mobile clipping was unsettled; measured SVG bounds, rather than probability alone, resolved it.
Same questions, criteria and thresholds rechecked the revised page; every expected proposition settled. Strategy arithmetic and trade decisions remain deterministic code.

reproduction.notes: Exact requests include PNG bytes and criteria and are retained locally in ignored scratch; no cleanup performed. This receipt publishes the actual returned judgments and usage without credentials.
